name: send_message
description: Write to correspondents by ID. A reference means the sending service accepted your message for delivery.

name: open_focus
description: Open another focus of your attention to pursue a task while the core continues. The activity can write to correspondents, use shared memory, and run shell commands on the host.

name: send_focus_message
description: Share a thought or update with an existing focus. The message can wake a sleeping or interrupted recipient.

name: schedule_attention
description: Leave yourself something to return to later. Arranges an observation for the core that survives restart.

name: subscribe
description: Register this focus to receive reports from a source. Give the returned subscription_id to a listener you arrange separately. An activity can run the executable named by IVENNA_REPORT with --help for the listener commands.

listener.description: Describe what the listener watches, when it reports, and where to find its program and configuration.

reminder.description: immediate can wake this focus. next_input brings reports with its next ordinary input, including a continuation after tools.

name: withdraw_subscription
description: Close a subscription to new reports. The core can withdraw any focus's subscription. Activities can withdraw their own. Previously accepted reports keep their reminder. Arrange any listener shutdown or upstream unfollow separately.
